newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares edge higher despite P&U tumble.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares edge higher despite P&U tumble.

text.p: Swedish shares ended higher on Thursday after a rise in drug company Astra offset a slide in rival Pharmacia & Upjohn.
The bourse's general index rose 0.41 percent to 2,113.58 in turnover of 3.6 billion crowns.

Pharmacia & Upjohn took centre stage, the share closing down 13.50 crowns at 229.50 but sliding 17 crowns at one stage. The fall came after finance director Bob Salisbury told analysts the consensus earnings forecast of $2.35 per share was about 10 cents too high.
The share had touched 251 crowns after P&U reported third quarter earnings of $204 million versus $231 million.
Astra jumped five crowns to close at 302. Most of the lift occurred in the last 10 minutes of trade.
"It can be that investors are selling Pharmacia & Upjohn and buying Astra," one broker said.
"The close was strong so we may very well see gains tomorrow," another broker said.
Vehicle maker Volvo rose 2.50 crowns to 136.50 in relatively lively turnover totalling 73 million crowns.
Steelmaker SSAB edged up 0.50 crown to 96 despite posting a 44 percent drop in nine-month profit after financial items at 1.60 billion crowns.
